description: This file contains bash shell functions for performing firmware upgrades and checks on MediaTek SoC devices, specifically targeting the MT7623 platform. It handles full system upgrades including partition handling, image validation, and device-specific upgrade steps.

methods.name: legacy_mtk_mmc_full_upgrade
methods.description: Performs a complete firmware upgrade for MediaTek devices, including partition and boot sector handling, with support for recovery and eMMC boot images.
